title: Quantum Simulation Circuits (QSC)
description: QSC benchmark schema: dynamical structure factor of a 1-D transverse-field Ising chain via a Ramsey-type protocol. Ground-state preparation, single-site Pauli perturbation, Hamiltonian evolution, and Pauli-basis measurement, swept over evolution time. Circuit construction and post-processing come from QSC-Applications (submodules/QSC-Applications).

benchmark_name.description: Name of the benchmark. Must be 'QSC' for this schema.

hamiltonian.description: Hamiltonian family. 'TFIM' is ZZ coupling with an X transverse field; 'BAEZ' is XX coupling with a Z transverse field, following doi/10.1073/pnas.2006103117.

num_qubits.description: Number of lattice sites in the chain.

pauli_terms.description: Hamiltonian terms. Two-character entries are applied to every neighbouring pair, one-character entries to every site. Note that 'BAEZ' overrides this with ['XX','Z'].

coefs.description: Coefficient for each Pauli term, keyed by the term string.

is_periodic.description: Closed (periodic) or open boundary conditions. 'BAEZ' supports open boundaries only.

dynamics.description: Whether to exponentiate the Hamiltonian exactly or synthesize an approximate evolution circuit.

experiment_class.description: 'DFS-CS' perturbs only the center site (12 circuits per time step). 'DFS-FULL' sweeps every site, so the batch grows with the chain length.

strength.description: Perturbation angle as a fraction of pi.

time_steps.description: Number of evolution times sampled on [0, T], endpoint inclusive, where T is set by the chain length.

perturbation_basis.description: Pauli basis (alpha) of the perturbation selected when computing the Green's function.

measurement_basis.description: Pauli basis (beta) measured when computing the Green's function.

output_dir.description: Directory QSC-Applications writes its experiment list and metadata to during circuit construction.

shots.description: Number of measurement shots per circuit.
